purpose: Checks a money market fund's placements against one pinned authority profile: the Saudi Capital Market Authority Investment Funds Regulations 2025, Article 56(a) to (j), as amended by Board Resolution 1-54-2025. From a fund's net asset value and a list of holdings with opaque issuer, counterparty and group tokens, it reports used percentage, cap, headroom and breach flag for each numeric limit: hedging derivatives, securitisation, single issuer, single counterparty, same group, fund units, weighted average life and liquidity. It also emits a maturity-bucket placement ladder and a stress-test frequency reminder. Government debt that meets the stated exemption is excluded from the concentration tests. Input types outside the permitted list, identifier-like tokens, non-hedging derivatives and any authority other than the pinned Saudi CMA profile are refused by name. Shariah eligibility of each holding is a caller input; the node does not assess it. Outputs are arithmetic and rule checks against the cited text, not a fatwa, Shariah certification, legal opinion or regulatory approval.
